controles.affirmation: AUCUNE AFFIRMATION JUDICIAIRE OU REGLEMENTAIRE OFFENSIVE. Le resume affirme au contraire "aucun litige significatif". Verifie de maniere adversariale.
controles.verbatim_source: URD 2025, chapitre litiges : "no single litigation is likely to have a material effect" ; provisions "related to all Group litigations amounted to 160.2 million euros" ; "To the best of the Group's knowledge, there is no exceptional event or litigation which has affected in the recent past or which is likely..."

controles.affirmation: CAGR ADVANCE de +6,1% sur 2022-2025 incluant +2,6 points d'Argentine, donc environ +3,5% hors Argentine
controles.verbatim_source: URD 2025 : "The compound annual comparable growth rate (CAGR) of the revenue over the 2022-2025 period reached +6.1% (1), in line with the ADVANCE plan's target of +5% to +6%" ; note "(1) Including +2.6% Argentina impact."

controles.affirmation: Le groupe publie deux colonnes, +2,0% avec l'Argentine et +1,7% hors Argentine, pour 2025
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025, annexe 5.1 : "Revenue -0.4% +0.8% +0.0% +0.8% -3.2% -0.5% -2.7% +2.0% +0.3% +1.7%" (colonnes : croissance comparable Groupe / impact Argentine / hors Argentine)

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE 1 : dette nette de 8 415 M EUR au 31 decembre 2025 a 13 921 M EUR au 30 juin 2026 (+65%), ratio 31,2% -> 45,1%
controles.verbatim_source: CP S1 2026 : "Net debt at June 30, 2026, reached 13,921 million euros" ; "The net debt-to-equity ratio, adjusted for dividend seasonality, stood at 45.1% at June 30, 2026, an increase compared to 31.2% at December 31, 2025" ; tableau : "Net Debt 9,793.7 8,415.5 13,921.0"

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE 2 : tresorerie d'exploitation S1 2026 de 1 954 M EUR (-34,4%), capex 1 828 M EUR, acquisitions 3 128 M EUR, dividendes 2 199 M EUR, emprunts nouveaux 3 585 M EUR ; neutralisation affacturage de 1 042 M EUR
controles.verbatim_source: "Net cash flows from operating activities 2,976.8 1,954.3" ; "Purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets (1,836.0) (1,828.4)" ; "Acquisition of consolidated companies and financial assets (83.3) (3,127.9)" ; "L'Air Liquide S.A. (1,951.0) (2,199.2)" ; "Increase (decrease) in borrowings 1,176.6 3,584.5" ; "the halt of factoring programs in the 1st half of 2026 strongly increased trade receivables by 1,042 million euros"

controles.affirmation: CHIFFRE 3 : ecart d'acquisition 16 195,6 M EUR au 30 juin 2026 contre 13 823,2 M EUR, soit 61% des capitaux propres (26 517 M EUR) et 28,8% du bilan (56 278 M EUR)
Intensite capitalistique moyenne superieure a 4 sur les decisions Electronique du S1 2026, contre une norme de 2,5 a 3,5 pour le segment
controles.verbatim_source: CP S1 2026 : "These investments are characterized by an average capital intensity (investment/sales) above 4, which is notably explained by the provision of electricity by the customer" ; URD 2025 : "Electronics has an average capital intensity between 2.5 and 3.5", "air gas production has a capital intensity of around 3", "hydrogen production by reforming has a capital intensity of between 1 and 2", "Industrial Merchant capital intensity to launch the business in a new market is between 1.5 and 2", "in Healthcare, capital intensity, excluding acquisitions, is around 1"

controles.affirmation: Projet ExxonMobil de Baytown retire du portefeuille ; FID Holcim Obourg conditionnee a des partenariats et a un soutien public
controles.verbatim_source: CP FY2025 : "The removal of the ExxonMobil project in Baytown, Texas, which the customer put on hold, was offset by the entry of new projects in Electronics" ; CP S1 2026 : "The Final Investment Decision (FID) for this project remains subject to the establishment of additional partnerships as well as public sector support"

controles.affirmation: Portefeuille 12 mois de 4,8 Mds EUR ; Electronique environ 50% du portefeuille ; plus d'un milliard d'euros de decisions Electronique au S1 2026, +46% vs le montant annuel 2025
controles.verbatim_source: "The 12-month portfolio of investment opportunities stood at a record level of 4.8 billion euros" ; "The Electronics business is the leading market represented in the portfolio, accounting for approximately 50% of the total" ; "reaching a record level of more than one billion euros in investment decisions in the first half, up 46% compared to the annual amount of decisions in 2025"

controles.affirmation: Efficacites 299 M EUR au S1 2026 (+4,0% vs 287 M EUR) ; effet prix Industriel Marchand +4,2% avec volumes "legerement en hausse" hors helium
controles.verbatim_source: "Efficiencies reached a record level of 299 million euros in the 1st half of 2026, an increase of +4.0% compared to" 287 ; "Industrial Merchant sales grew by +3.2% in the 1st half of 2026, supported notably by strong sales growth in China in the 2nd quarter and a high price effect (+4.2%) globally. Volumes were impacted by the interruption of a helium source following the Middle East conflict. Excluding helium, gas volumes were slightly up"

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle Linde de 27,5% au T2 2026, contre 20,9% pour Air Liquide au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Linde 10-Q du 31 juillet 2026 : "Sales $ 9,289 $ 8,495" et "Operating Profit 2,554 2,354", soit 27,5%

controles.affirmation: Taux de distribution 63% en 2025 contre 55% en 2021 ; Electronique 2 465 M EUR en 2025 contre 2 510 M EUR en 2024
controles.verbatim_source: URD 2025 : "Pay-out ratio 55% 58% 56% 59% 63%" ; CP FY2025 : "Electronics 2,510 2,465 -1.8% +1.2%" et "Electronics revenue was down -2.5% in 2025, but posted strong growth (+8.5%) excluding Equipment & Installation"
controles.correction_proposee: Les valeurs 2022 (2 558 M EUR pour l'Electronique, +6,1% de croissance comparable Gaz et Services, 378 M EUR d'efficacites) proviennent des URD 2022 et 2023, absents du data-lake. Elles sont coherentes avec kpis-haut mais n'ont pas pu etre recoupees sur document source dans ce controle.
